source = '''def transform(grid):
    """Composite four 3x6 color panels using priority 5 > 4 > 8 > 2."""
    panels = [grid[i:i + 3] for i in range(0, 12, 3)]
    out = [[0] * 6 for _ in range(3)]
    for color in (2, 8, 4, 5):
        panel = next(panel for panel in panels if any(color in row for row in panel))
